purpose: Prepare Stage 4 to integrate qualified regulatory evidence from multiple datasets without pooling incomparable biological units or changing the frozen NIH-CARD primary estimand.

architecture.core_stage4: NIH-CARD paired RNA↔ATAC correspondence remains the sole primary Stage-4 experiment.
architecture.evidence_stack: Other datasets attach as independent evidence channels after source-specific qualification.
architecture.no_meta_pooling: Cells/nuclei from different cohorts are never concatenated into one biological n. Donor/study-level evidence stays source-specific.
architecture.no_outcome_selection: Source inclusion, mapping rules, program definitions, and interpretation logic must be frozen before protected outcomes are opened.

canonical_unit.program_definition: A frozen gene/regulatory module or eRegulon-like object. Edge-level objects are allowed only if donor stability and mapping identity qualify.
canonical_unit.effect_summary_rule: Source-specific statistics retain their own scale; they are not forced into the Stage-4 Delta scale.
canonical_unit.missing_rule: Unavailable evidence is MISSING/NOT_MEASURED, never numeric zero.
canonical_unit.disagreement_rule: Conflicting source evidence is preserved as disagreement; do not select the favorable source.

NIH_CARD_STAGE4.interpretation: Tests correspondence under frozen measured-nuisance and matched-control design. Hidden within-donor cross-modal confounding remains a known limitation.

SCENIC_PLUS_EXTERNAL.preferred_development_source: GSE214979 or superior audited external paired-multiome cohort
SCENIC_PLUS_EXTERNAL.stage4_use: Defines prospectively frozen program/edge groupings that Stage-4 and replication datasets may score; does not borrow Stage-4 outcome to choose the network.
SCENIC_PLUS_EXTERNAL.forbidden: Do not use historical Stage75F 10-TF/96-row object as validated broad GRN.

MORABITO_GSE174367.stage4_use: After program definitions and replication estimand are frozen, test whether the regulatory relationship recurs across separate nuclei/donors.

SEAAD_PUBLIC_MULTIOME.stage4_use: Test same-nucleus chromatin/RNA support for frozen programs using donor-wise inference.
SEAAD_PUBLIC_MULTIOME.limitation: SEA-AD contributed to FULL104; this is not pristine independent-cohort confirmation.

GSE272082.stage4_use: Potential independent same-nucleus replication after exact acquisition/custody/feature-support audit.

studies.GSE301119: auxiliary myeloid; target engagement qualified; 2 donors; macrophage
studies.GSE289721: candidate microglial CRISPRi; 6 targets; engagement/control qualification pending

PERTURBATION.stage4_use: For frozen regulatory programs with eligible perturbed regulators/targets, test predicted direction of downstream program displacement.
PERTURBATION.forbidden: Do not aggregate non-independent screens or use exposed development outcomes as pristine confirmation.

SEAAD_SPATIAL.stage4_use: Where panel support permits, test recurrence of frozen regulatory/RNA programs in intact tissue.
SEAAD_SPATIAL.limitation: Current recovered panels do not cover the complete state; supporting only.

integration_sequence: 1_FREEZE_PROGRAM_SOURCE: build/audit the external regulatory program definitions without Stage-4 outcomes.
2_CROSSWALK: map every program gene/region/TF to NIH-CARD, FULL104, Morabito, SEA-AD multiome, perturbation and spatial feature vocabularies; emit measured/missing masks.
3_STAGE4_CORE: execute NIH-CARD Stage-4 once under its frozen authority; preserve its independent result.
4_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_SCORING: apply the already-frozen program definitions separately to each eligible external source.
5_TRIANGULATION_LEDGER: assemble one evidence record per source x program without pooling biological units.
6_INTERPRETATION: classify support by nuisance class attacked and limitations retained.
7_TEACHER_ELIGIBILITY: only programs with prospectively defined sufficient evidence may become candidates for the privileged teacher-state producer.
8_RECOVERABILITY: split candidate teacher regulatory state into Z_reg_shared vs Z_reg_private using RNA TRAIN/VALIDATION only.

interpretation_matrix.minimum_rule: No single evidence class is sufficient by itself to label a teacher regulatory component universal biology.
interpretation_matrix.stage4_positive_only: correspondence supported under measured nuisance basis; hidden within-donor cross-modal confounding remains possible
interpretation_matrix.stage4_plus_external_network: adds feature-definition independence if network was built externally and frozen prospectively
interpretation_matrix.plus_morabito: attacks same-nucleus coupling and FULL104 donor overlap
interpretation_matrix.plus_same_nucleus_external: adds exact-cell multimodal recurrence in another cohort if GSE272082 qualifies
interpretation_matrix.plus_perturbation: adds causal-direction support for covered regulators/programs
interpretation_matrix.plus_spatial: adds intact-tissue support where panel coverage permits

required_before_any_real_selection: minimum evidence-class rule frozen without looking at outcomes
teacher_candidate_policy.default_conservative_rule: Programs may be nominated for teacher-state construction only after Stage-4 interpretability plus at least one independent evidence family with a different dominant failure mode. This is a design default to be red-teamed before real outcomes; it is not a production threshold yet.
teacher_candidate_policy.no_score: Do not create a single weighted evidence score across modalities unless a prospective calibration study later justifies one.
